Invalid transitions will include explicit examples X1–X3 plus all remaining forbidden pairs under DEC-02. A 5-state machine contains 20 possible directed edges; only five are valid.

The five states are OPEN, IN_PROGRESS, RESOLVED, CLOSED, and CANCELLED. Valid transitions are T1 (OPEN → IN_PROGRESS), T2 (IN_PROGRESS → RESOLVED), T3 (RESOLVED → CLOSED), T4 (OPEN → CANCELLED), and T5 (IN_PROGRESS → CANCELLED). DEC-02 remains open, but Option A is the default until DEC changes. The initial state is OPEN, and CLOSED and CANCELLED are terminal states.
